meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 调用这个技能时,Claude 会安装 OneCLI 并初始化它的 Agent Vault 凭据库,把 .env 里的密钥迁入其中,再重新构建、重启服务并验证结果。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更之后,或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。也可在 OneCLI 需要从头初始化时使用。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI 凭据库
say.note: Claude 会检查现状,然后安装并配置 OneCLI。

say.text: 把 .env 里的密钥迁移到 OneCLI 里
say.note: Claude 会扫描 .env,迁移后删除原密钥行。
Claude 会执行完整的初始化流程。

howto.what_en: When invoked, this skill makes Claude install OneCLI, initialize its Agent Vault, migrate existing .env credentials into it, then rebuild, restart, and verify the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when OneCLI needs to be set up from scratch.

say_en.text: Initialize the OneCLI credential vault for me.
say_en.note: Claude checks state, then installs and configures OneCLI.
Claude scans .env, migrates keys, removes them.

say_en.text: I just ran /update-nanoclaw, help me set up OneCLI.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full initialization flow.
